name: Dr. Syed Mozaffar
bio: Dr. Syed Mozaffar founded The Muscular Junction to bring genuinely evidence-based physiotherapy to Islamabad. He specialises in sports injury rehabilitation and advanced manual therapy, and leads the clinic's professional workshops on dry needling, cupping, Mulligan and HVLA techniques for practising clinicians across Pakistan.

name: Dr. Abdul Wahab
bio: Dr. Abdul Wahab works with children and adults, using play-based sessions to help them reach their motor milestones — and coaching parents so the progress continues at home between visits.

name: Dr. M. Abdullah
bio: Dr. M. Abdullah supports children through developmental and neurological rehabilitation programmes, designing sessions that hold a child's attention while still delivering the repetition recovery depends on.

name: Dr. Niha Batool
bio: Dr. Niha leads care for female patients who prefer a female therapist, working across musculoskeletal and post-operative rehabilitation to help patients regain mobility, balance and independence after injury or surgery.
